description: Analyzes operations in the current session from the session JSONL log, identifies large text blocks from file-based tools (Read, Write, Edit), compresses them, and stores them in the cache to reduce future token usage. Returns a summary of the optimization.

min_token_threshold.description: Minimum token count for a file operation to be considered for compression. Defaults to 30.

sessionId.description: Optional session ID to optimize. If not provided, uses the current active session.

name: optimize_session
